graph.name: Consider recovery after an apology · Pre
graph.description:
Use a settled apology to propose a recovery update for temporary actor conditions.

Lesson: Recovery updates a temporary condition from settled events while retaining separately supported guarded beliefs. The next Pre workflow reads that committed state and expresses a reaction; a proposal alone never becomes memory.

Limitations: Full Post root Run writes memory without a review-click. A separate zero-call Curve example needs an already initialized curve; it does not infer emotion.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change the settled apology from accepted to acknowledged without acceptance; inspect whether Recovery preserves the stronger unresolved condition.
Run to Internalize, inspect its sourceRefs, then compare a full root Run's settlement and save diagnostics before using the Pre companion.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Settled event: Sol apologized for reading Mira's letter. She accepted the apology.

Proposed update: Immediate anger eases. Trust remains guarded until later behavior supplies more evidence.

Post evidence → proposal → settlement: Keep State+Events→Internalize Recovery→Commit in a Post root workflow. Full Run may write actor memory without a review-click; report local update separately from confirmed saving.

Pre sources → interpretation → delivery: Wire Scene+State→Reflect Character, Reflect→Express Behavior, then Guidance; also feed the same Scene/State to Express. This companion reads actual committed state, never the Post proposal directly.

Recovery is evidence-based: Both model nodes need local Analysis bindings. This recipe has at most one request per phase. A zero-call Curve alternative requires an initialized curve and cannot infer the truth of an emotion.

Conversation after apology (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read the last four exchanges and Mira's card to express the changed state in the next immediate interaction.
Fixture: Chat: After Mira accepted the apology, Sol asks whether they can continue sorting the letters. Mira's next response remains unwritten.
Inspect: Confirm this is the current scene and no later behavior already settled full trust restoration. Pre reads do not write memory.

Recovery's current state (pre-state)
Purpose: Read the current native actor State, including only changes actually settled by the Post companion.
Inspect: Compare its version and conditions with the Post result. A Post proposal preview must not appear here as if committed; wire this state to both Reflect and Express.

Calmer, still guarded (pre-reflect)
Purpose: Create Reflection Data translating current state and the new request into optional behavior hints.
Inspect: Inspect behaviorHints and evidence labels. The reaction should reflect the loaded state, not the desired specimen or an uncommitted proposal.

Guarded cooperation hints (pre-express)
Purpose: Render the reflection's behaviorHints into Guidance without another model request.
Inspect: Expect the selected hints verbatim; Output tokens and Instructions are inactive in Behavior. Wire matching Context and State to validate assessment evidence.

Recovery behavior direction (pre-guidance)
Purpose: Deliver the next-response brief with room for a calm gesture and a retained boundary.
Inspect: Inspect the Host result for eased reaction and guarded trust as separate ideas. A host reply may settle new events for a later Post run; this Pre output is only advice.

pre-reflect.title: Reflect · character
pre-reflect.instructions: Appraise Sol's request to continue sorting letters against Mira's actual current state. If temporary anger eased while trust remains guarded, propose quieter cooperation with a concrete boundary about handling her letters. Put two concise options in behaviorHints. Do not restore trust by convenience, reopen anger without evidence, force reconciliation or decide the player's feelings/actions. Separate observed acceptance, interpreted easing and possible next behavior. If state lacks the expected recovery, say less instead of assuming the Post companion ran.
